Parent class for all drawable objects

drawable.Rd

drawable enforces structure on its subclasses: every drawable must carry a style and expose a computed points property, of class point_set. It is not intended to be instantiated directly; use one of its subclasses (shape_raw, shape_circle, shape_blob, shape_ribbon, shape_twist) instead.

Usage

drawable(...)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed to style().
